Thanks Oliver — quick follow-up.

I pulled the W-9; the EIN (12-3456789) on the form resolves to an entity name that differs slightly from the business name you provided (IRS records show a different DBA/owner historically). To keep procurement and payments compliant we need one of the following:

- A copy of the SS-4 confirmation or IRS CP 575 (EIN assignment letter) showing AuroraTech LLC and the EIN, OR
- A notarized affidavit confirming the DBA linkage between AuroraTech LLC and "Aurora Labs" plus an acceptable bank letter, OR
- If the legal owner is a parent entity, a signed statement on company letterhead authorizing AuroraTech LLC to invoice on its behalf plus supporting tax docs.

If you can upload the SS-4 or CP575 that will speed validation.

Separately: we can consider issuing a temporary PO for the pilot (Finance approval required). Ben and Laura, could you triage an expedited pilot PO (small value) if vendor provides SS-4/affidavit? Provide timeline and any conditional controls (payment hold, limited term).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — target is to have the PO in place before your pilot start on 12/13.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Operations | Redwood Inference
